# Narration Usage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NarrationUsage`](gmeow-NarrationUsage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NarrationUsage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/narrative`](../../slices/narrative.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The reified seam link — segment × narrated subject × mode, for when HOW the text carries the content matters: flashback, dream, hypothetical, unreliable narration. Mint one per (segment, subject) pair needing mode/vantage/confidence; the 80% case stays flat [`gmeow:narrates`](../properties/gmeow-narrates.md) (efficiency doctrine — reify-on-demand, [Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)). Whose reading of the mode it is rides the statement layer; competing modes for one narration usage are coexisting relators, none privileged ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:NarrationUsage`](gmeow-NarrationUsage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
